gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all notification schemes to understand how notifications are configured for different projects.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a list of notification schemes, including their IDs and names.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new notification scheme to customize notifications for a new project.
gold.ideal: A successful response indicating the creation of the notification scheme with its ID.

gold.user: As a project lead, I need to see which notification schemes are mapped to my projects to ensure proper communication.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a mapping of projects to their respective notification schemes.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to view the details of a specific notification scheme to understand its configuration.
gold.ideal: A successful response with the details of the specified notification scheme.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to update an existing notification scheme to add new notification types.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming the update of the notification scheme.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to add notifications to a scheme to ensure team members are informed of important updates.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming that notifications have been added to the scheme.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to delete an obsolete notification scheme to keep the system organized.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming the deletion of the notification scheme.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to remove a specific notification from a scheme to reduce unnecessary alerts.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming the removal of the notification from the scheme.
